# Generated HEIC test images

These are synthetic images generated for this project using Pillow and pillow-heif. They contain no real photographs or metadata. `workout.heic` is a 64×48 RGB gradient. `workout-10bit.heic` is a 32×24 solid-color, 10-bit HEIC image. Browser tests use the files as HEIC and as HEIF with missing MIME metadata, then verify local WebP conversion. They are not loaded into production bundles.
